articles.title: Inspecting claim Venezuela's Hugo Carvajal released list of politicians who took kickbacks
articles.summary: Social media posts from December 2025 claim Hugo Carvajal, Venezuela's former chief of national intelligence, released a list of U.S. politicians. These individuals are allegedly accused of receiving millions of dollars. This serious international accusation, involving a former foreign intelligence head and U.S. political figures, underscores the impact of unverified claims circulating on social media regarding sensitive geopolitical matters.

articles.title: ICICI Pru pre-IPO round brings in 26 investors
articles.summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management successfully concluded a pre-IPO share sale, raising approximately ₹4,900 crore. The significant fundraising effort saw participation from 26 diverse investors, including prominent foreign and domestic institutions alongside various family offices. This major financial transaction in Mumbai indicates strong market interest and confidence in the company ahead of its impending public listing.

articles.title: Australia approves Hanwha's larger stake in Austal with strict conditions
articles.summary: Australia has approved South Korean firm Hanwha's proposal to nearly double its stake in Australian shipbuilder Austal. While this signifies international collaboration and investment, the deal is subject to stringent conditions to safeguard national interests. This move is significant for Australia's defence industry, balancing foreign investment with national security in a strategic sector like shipbuilding.
